One ability is trained at a time, in this order. Each day brings a theory card and a scenario, and a real-life task once the last one is reported. 6 reviewed answers to scenarios and real-life tasks at the current level, averaging 3 of 4 or better over 4 days, unlock a level check; 3 or more on it raises the level. Theory cards are reviewed and recalled but do not count. An ability you moved on from gets a review card now and then and drops a level if its reviews fall.
Level check unlocked: 3 or more on it raises the level
